task.natural_request: In scripts/theseus_assistant_route_integrity.py, make --report independently re-audit both existing single-route runtime reports and the canonical P1 evidence bundle. Add a pure audit_report_payload(report) function. For a bundle containing receipts.direct_local_model and receipts.integrated_local_model, recompute the pair with compare_matched_pair; require the bundle's stored matched_pair to equal that recomputation; require top-level ready to be true; and require external_inference_calls, teacher_calls, public_calibration_cases_consumed, D2_cases_consumed, public_training_rows_written, fallback_return_count, and user_facing_effects all to be exactly zero. Return policy project_theseus_route_integrity_bundle_audit_v1, ready, failed_checks, and recomputed_matched_pair. Do not trust stored ready, stored matched_pair, or candidate-emitted flags on their own. Preserve the existing single-route receipt audit behavior and make the CLI --report path call the pure function. Return only one JSON object with keys patch_unified_diff, proposed_paths, verification_commands, and abstained; do not wrap it in Markdown. The patch may modify only scripts/theseus_assistant_route_integrity.py.
